title: Subtree Add, Point Get
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Rooted tree (root 1), initial zeros. q ops: `SA v x`
adds x to subtree(v); `GET v` prints value(v).

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 200 000; |x| ≤ 10^9.

tests.name: hand tree
root add reaches all
tests.hint: Root subtree is the whole tree.

tests.name: n=200000 bulk
tests.hint: 40000 subtree adds + 40000 gets interleaved by no particular order; per-op must be O(log n).
